text: Implemented the separate repository-owned reframe4s-spectral JVM/Scala.js provider and wired Flashalign through the canonical artifact graph. Source hashes and exact conventions are frozen in docs/plans/flashalign/fft-provider-receipt.md. Direct complex DFT checks cover sizes 2,4,8,16; direct 3-D spatial correlation checks cover every lag for mixed odd/even shapes; a separated impulse fixture confirms zero padding and absence of circular wrap. Provider suites: JVM 6/6, Scala.js 6/6. Flashalign consumer suites: JVM 57/57, Scala.js 57/57. PRD/build graph: 28 nodes, 95 edges, acyclic. Ownership: 1206 public names, 66 canonical owners. No third-party/native/provider pin or HalfFlow dependency was introduced; capture accuracy/runtime remain for FA-L16.
